listen_addr.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)

port.description: TCP port the server listens on

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

user.description: System user account under which the server runs

group.description: System group under which the server runs

document_root.description: Root directory from which files are served

index_files.description: List of filenames to try as default index for directories

enable_directory_listings.description: Whether to display directory contents if no index file exists

mime_types_file.description: Path to the file defining MIME type mappings

access_log.description: Path to the access log file

error_log.description: Path to the error log file

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format)

ssl_private_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format)

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of HTTP request body (in bytes, e.g., 10485760 = 10 MB)

cache_dir.description: Directory used for caching static content

cache_max_size.description: Maximum cache directory size in bytes (512 MB default)

virtual_hosts.description: List of virtual hosts to configure (empty list disables vhost support)

name.description: Descriptive name for the virtual host

hostname.description: Domain name this virtual host responds to (e.g., example.com)

document_root.description: Document root specific to this virtual host

index_files.description: Override top-level index files for this virtual host only

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for this virtual host only

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file for this vhost (PEM format)

ssl_private_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file for this vhost (PEM format)
